To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The spirit of place is the most effective tool to understand the socio cultural impacts and value of heritage in a tourism context.
the value of cultural resources and the value of tourism are interrelated.
the socio cultural impacts are the most difficult to manage and the most damaging to the value of heritage, but the least studied.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the socio cultural dimension and the impact of tourism on heritage, and the management of heritage as a sustainable tourism resource.
how tourism affects the socio cultural dimension and value of cultural heritage.
the relationship between tourism and cultural heritage, and the implications of tourism development on the cultural values and the cultural heritage of communities.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
tourism is an integral part of cultural heritage and that the two cannot be separated, especially in the case of World Heritage sites.
the socio cultural dimension should be the main concern in the management of cultural heritage sites.
tourism is not a threat to heritage but rather a catalyst for the development and sustainability of heritage.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
heritage is not a static concept and it is not only about the past.
tourism development is not sustainable unless it is based on the socio cultural values of the local people and the environment.
heritage management in the context of tourism is a complex process, which involves multiple actors, multiple stakeholders, multiple sectors and multiple scales.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the socio cultural dimension is an integral component of the management of heritage tourism and that the spirit of place is a useful conceptual framework in the management of such sites.
the socio cultural dimension is a crucial aspect of heritage that needs to be understood, protected and managed.
tourism can be used to enhance the social and economic value of heritage, but it can also have a negative impact on heritage values.
